The massive tsunami wave continues to be visible in the distance over the trees.
The view remains fixed on the approaching wall of white water in the ocean.
The long line of the tsunami wave stretches across the horizon.
The camera holds steady, showing the tsunami wave approaching the coastline.
The tsunami appears to be getting closer, its white crest prominent against the grey sky.
The view of the approaching tsunami continues from a high vantage point over some trees.
People can be heard shouting in the background as the wave approaches.
The camera pans slightly, revealing more of the treeline and the vastness of the wave.
The camera pans left, showing more of the hillside and facility grounds in the foreground.
The view returns to the center, focused on the approaching tsunami.
The camera remains steady on the distant but massive wave.
The tsunami wave continues its steady advance toward the shore.
The voices in the background grow more urgent as the wave nears.

The camera continues to pan right across the industrial facility grounds.

The view shows the sprawling industrial complex with the tsunami visible in the background.
The tsunami wave is now very close to the seawall in the background.
The camera quickly tilts down to show a concrete water channel below the viewpoint.
The camera shows the water inside the channel, which appears to be rising.

The camera remains focused on the water level rising in the concrete channel.
The water continues to rise steadily within the concrete enclosure.
The camera stays on the rising water, showing reflections on the concrete wall.

The camera begins to pan up from the water channel.
The camera quickly pans up to show the tsunami wave breaching the seawall and flooding the plant.
Floodwater rapidly surges across the facility grounds, moving toward the camera's position.
The white car is seen in the path of the fast-moving floodwater.
The torrent of water flows past industrial pipes and buildings.
The ground level of the facility is quickly being inundated by the tsunami surge.
The camera pans to follow the destructive flow of water through the complex.
The floodwater rises rapidly, showing significant turbulence.
The camera tilts down towards the area directly below the viewing platform.
A massive wave of water crashes over a wall and into the channel below.
The camera shakes as the powerful surge of water fills the area below.
Turbulent, churning water violently fills the concrete basin.
The water level rises dramatically as the surge continues to pour in.
White, foamy water crashes against pipes and railings.

The water churns violently, completely submerging the structures below.
The camera focuses on the powerful current swirling within the flooded area.
Water continues to gush over the wall with incredible speed and volume.
The entire lower level is now a raging torrent of brown floodwater.
The water level has risen almost to the height of the yellow safety railings.
The turbulent water swirls and crashes inside the flooded basin.
The view shows the chaotic surface of the deep, fast-moving floodwater.
The camera pans across the flooded area, showing the extent of the inundation.
The water continues to flow with great force, creating powerful currents.
The camera pans right, revealing orange lifebuoy containers on a wall surrounded by water.
The floodwater is now deep, with its surface swirling chaotically.
The camera continues panning over the vast, turbulent body of floodwater.
The high-angle shot shows the power plant's infrastructure submerged in the flood.
A strong current is visible, flowing from right to left across the screen.
Water surges against the base of the structure where the camera operator is standing.
The view shows the turbulent water flowing past orange equipment boxes on a railing.
The shot ends with a view of the relentlessly flowing, churning floodwater.

**JSON Caption Creation: Fukushima Daini Tsunami Video**

Alright, let's get down to it. I need to generate 60 captions, each representing one second of this video footage depicting the Fukushima Daini nuclear power plant during the 2011 tsunami.  I've thoroughly analyzed the video's content second by second, and the user requires a JSON output. This means I'll need to create a JSON array of objects, each containing a start and end timestamp (HH:MM:SS.mmm format) and a concise caption describing the visual content for that one-second interval.

Given the nature of the footage, I'll need to be accurate and descriptive without over-interpreting. The focus is on the visual progression of the tsunami and its impact on the plant infrastructure. I'll need to pay close attention to the details: the initial approach of the waves, the breaching of the sea wall, the flooding of the grounds, and the swirling water.

Based on my understanding of the event and the specific visual data, here's what I'll do: I'll convert the textual second-by-second description into meaningful captions. I will also make sure the format of the output is a valid JSON array. I am confident I can generate this data accurately.
